summary: Authors data transformation pipelines, inspired by dplyr and jq — fetches tabular data (JSON, CSV, inline records) and composes filter / select / mutate / group / sort / join / flatten / unique / format operations.
in_scope: Fetching JSON or CSV over HTTP (read-only)
Filter, select, mutate, group, sort, take, join, flatten, unique, format operations
Working with inline literal record arrays
out_of_scope: Charting and visualization (bar, line, heatmap) — produces transformed data, doesn't render it
Writing back to the source (POST/PUT, mutating remote data)
Database queries (SQL, GraphQL, NoSQL) — HTTP JSON/CSV only
Interactive assessments or forms — transformation only, not an interaction surface
Window functions / lag / lead / row-referential formulas across rows
Host-app embedding or UI rendering — emit data, consumer renders
